description: Server half of custom item types and their industry blueprints (data/*.json packs): adds the item type rows and blueprint definitions in memory at startup, without writing EveJS tables. The client needs the matching data from client/apply_client_data.py. Off by default (EVEJS_CUSTOMTYPES_ENABLED). Optional blueprint shop: public NPC item exchange contracts with the pack blueprints in the trade hubs (EVEJS_CUSTOMTYPES_SHOP_ENABLED).
